on the Dragon Isles.]] Gorlocs (or gurlocs) are "an arctic race of murloc-like creatures". Most gorlocs are members of tribes that battle the tuskarr and wolvar in the Borean Tundra and Sholazar Basin respectively. The Borean gorlocs appear to be as hostile and primitive as average murlocs. The Sholazar gorlocs, the Oracles, were given intelligence and awareness by exposure to Titan technology. They are an advanced group of gorloc tribes who have formed their own faction, and are fighting the Frenzyheart Tribe of wolvar in Sholazar. Gotura Fourwinds is a tauren shaman found in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. At the beginning of the Elemental Unrest, he informed the adventurers about the situation. Gorsik the Tumultuous is an elite stone lord located in Crimson Expanse, Deepholm. Symbolizing earth's potential for change, Gorsik is more impulsive and temperamental than most of his brothers. He is more similar to Boden the Imposing in this regard. He is charged with clearing the Crimson Expanse of the corruption and stone troggs that infest the area. Ruberick appears to be in his service.

Gorshak War Camp is located on the Devouring Breach's eastern side, southeast of Bloodgulch and northeast of Firebeard's Patrol. It was once a sizable Dragonmaw clan base, made up of a great hall, a kennel, a forge and protected by several watch towers and blade throwers.

While most of them ran away from the abomination, Lolo the Lookout did not, causing Goutgut and Lolo to become friends. He infiltrated Thelsamar and stole an important document from the Explorers' League, before fleeing to his hideout, where he can now be found sitting in front of a campfire, keeping the document he stole close by; courier Morick Darkbrew can sometimes be found nearby.

When severely injured, Warmaster Blackhorn drains health directly from Goriona. The Gorgrond storyline is the level-up experience in Gorgrond on . The Gorgrond storyline is unique in that the decision of which building gets built at the player's Garrison outpost (either Highpass or Beastwatch for the Alliance or Horde, respectively) affects how the rest of the zone storyline plays out. The lumber mill option will send players to the jungle overgrowth of southern Gorgrond, while the sparring arena option instead sends players to the brutal wastelands of northern Gorgrond. Whichever chain does not get chosen will unlock a number of bonus objectives that take place where players would have been directed to quest. The Gorian Empire (also referred to as the Gorian ogre imperium or simply the Ogre Empire) was the nation-state of the ogres encompassing various holdings on Draenor. On , it was notable for being one of the few empires on the world, but lost its former dominance after the rise of the Iron Horde, which forced to align himself with the orcs to ensure his empire's continued survival. He would have, however, turned himself against the orcs if the situation was favorable. They are referred to as high ogres.

:"Impossible is only what we allow it to be." Rommath (pronounced "ROH-mehth") is the Grand Magister of Quel'Thalas—the leader of the Magisters, the blood elves' traditional order of magi. He is one of Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron's personal advisors, Ranger General Halduron Brightwing being another. Rommath also holds the title of Archmage, and long served the Kirin Tor before cutting ties with the conclave after the Third War. Rommath was a close companion of Kael'thas Sunstrider, to whom Rommath was fiercely devoted. Mildred "Gramma" Stonefield is a human quest giver located at the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest. She is the oldest living member of the Stonefield family. Mildred, unlike most of the rest of the Stonefields, is against the feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures, seeing it as harmful and unnecessary. She goes to lengths to help her grandson, Tommy Joe Stonefield, be united with his forbidden love, Maybell Maclure. She is an old friend of William Pestle and enlists his help when trying to bring the two lovers together. She can be found in the Stonefield house.

Grand master engineer goggles are a variety of head-worn items created by Engineers with grand master-level engineering skill or greater. Each class is offered training to create only a select variety of these, usually limited to a single type. These goggles may be created by characters as low as level 65, but are limited to characters level 72 or greater. They are all Bind on Pickup and so cannot be made for another character.

The Grand Commendation system, introduced in patch 5.1.0, allows players to boost reputation gains for all characters on their account with certain Pandaria factions. Each Grand Commendation is bought for a small sum of gold from the corresponding faction quartermaster. It is a quality item that must be used after purchase to take effect. Simply having a Grand Commendation in one's bag does nothing. Grand Commendations are unlocked upon reaching reputation with the corresponding faction, and once used, double all reputation gains with that faction for all characters on the account, including the character who originally reached revered. The Grand Commendation of the Dominance Offensive is a Grand Commendation available at reputation with the Dominance Offensive faction. It doubles all reputation gains with the Dominance Offensive faction for all characters on the same account, including the character who originally reached revered. A lesser-known, undocumented feature of this Grand Commendation is that it also unlocks double reputation gains for the faction's Alliance counterpart, Operation: Shieldwall.

The Grand Commendation of the August Celestials will unlock a 100% bonus reputation gain with the August Celestials for all characters on the account of the character who uses it. It costs and requires with August Celestials.

The Grand Commendation of Operation: Shieldwall is a Grand Commendation available at reputation with the Operation: Shieldwall faction. It doubles all reputation gains with the Operation: Shieldwall faction for all characters on the same account, including the character who originally reached revered. A lesser-known, undocumented feature of this Grand Commendation is that it also unlocks double reputation gains for the faction's Horde counterpart, the Dominance Offensive.
